NONE: › used when you think someone is silly or very surprising
一定是個玩笑；準不是真的（用於你認為某人愚蠢或非常令人吃驚的情況）
› said when you are not certain if it is really worth making a great effort to get something
這值得嗎？（當不確定是否值得做某事時說的話）
› used to say that the answer to a question you have just been asked is obviously 'yes'
（用於表示答案毫無疑問是肯定的）教皇是天主教徒嗎?這還用問嗎?
